# NCLEX-RN Todo List

## **1. Study & Content Review**
- [ ] Get a review book (Kaplan, HESI, Saunders)
- [ ] Identify weak content areas
- [ ] Review pharmacology systematically
- [ ] Study disease processes and nursing interventions
- [ ] Master lab values and normal ranges
- [ ] Review prioritization frameworks (ABC, Maslow's)

## **2. Practice Questions**
- [ ] Complete 3,000+ practice questions
- [ ] Use official NCSBN test bank
- [ ] Review rationales for every wrong answer
- [ ] Aim for 75%+ accuracy before exam
- [ ] Practice timed questions to build speed

## **3. Test-Taking Strategies**
- [ ] Learn to identify question types (SATA, drag-drop, etc.)
- [ ] Study NCLEX-style question formats
- [ ] Learn keywords in questions (EXCEPT, FIRST, BEST, MOST)
- [ ] Practice elimination strategies
- [ ] Study common distractors

## **4. Prepare Mentally**
- [ ] Take full-length practice exams
- [ ] Build test-taking stamina
- [ ] Manage test anxiety
- [ ] Get adequate sleep before exam day
- [ ] Review test day logistics (location, what to bring)

## **5. Register & Plan**
- [ ] Register with your state board
- [ ] Schedule exam date strategically
- [ ] Plan study timeline (8-10 weeks typical)
- [ ] Budget for review courses/materials

**Good luck! You've got this! 💪**
